author: Lintuxer
tagline: The editor behind Nextcloud & friends — set JWT_SECRET before you connect one
description:
**Change `JWT_SECRET` first** (Advanced → environment). It is the same
placeholder for everyone who installs this, and it is what an integration
authenticates with.

ONLYOFFICE Docs Community Edition — the engine that renders and edits
Word, Excel and PowerPoint files inside Nextcloud, Seafile, ownCloud and
others. It brings no portal of its own: opening it shows a status page,
not a document library. Point your file app at
`http://<zimaos-ip>:8090/` and give it the same secret.

Runs as one container, keeps logs, certificates and its conversion cache
under /DATA/AppData/onlyoffice, and needs no database — the Community
Edition ships without PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ and Redis.
title: ONLYOFFICE Docs
